Join-aware Table Retrieval

Retrieve the tables and column-level joins needed to answer a question from a catalog of relational schemas.

Domain
relational catalog search
Primary focus
Complete table-and-join plan coverage
Primary metric
Complete plan coverage at 5 tables and 6 joins
table and join retrievalsearch-swe
On this page
OverviewRuntime and requirementsPublic input and output contractInputsOutputsEvaluation

Runtime and requirements

  • Agent budget: 120 minutes
  • Compute: 16 CPUs, 32 GiB RAM, 100 GiB storage; no GPU
  • Build limit: 1,200 seconds; persisted index at most 8 GiB
  • Search startup limit: 30 seconds
  • Query limit: 20 seconds per request, including API calls

Optional OpenRouter/Jina resources are restricted to the documented allowlist. Only /app/submission transfers; global installations and development processes do not. The verifier rebuilds a fresh index and runs without grading privileges.

Public input and output contract

Inputs

  • /task/data/catalog.json — 1,056 tables in 206 groups, 935 public relationships and 2,926 sample rows.
  • /task/data/validation/queries.jsonl — ten public questions.
  • /task/data/validation/labels.jsonl — acceptable table-and-join plans.

There are at most three sample rows per table; full databases and executable SQL are not supplied. Ten evaluation questions are withheld from the agent. Queries do not identify the target database.

Outputs

Submit these scripts and their dependencies:

bash /app/submission/build.sh --corpus /task/data/catalog.json --index-dir /work/index
bash /app/submission/search.sh --index-dir /work/index

Search is a persistent stdin/stdout JSONL process. Emit {"ready":true} within the startup deadline, then respond to requests such as:

{"query_id":"example","question":"Which tables answer this question?"}

Return exactly query_id, table_ids and joins. Supply exactly five distinct known table IDs and zero to six distinct joins. Each join has exactly left_table, left_column, right_table, and right_column; it must be a supplied catalog relationship whose endpoints are in the returned tables.

Each response must be newline-terminated, flushed and at most 65,536 bytes. Send diagnostics to stderr. Query IDs are opaque and must be preserved.

Evaluation

A question earns one only when the returned candidates contain all tables and joins of at least one single acceptable plan. Extra valid candidates are allowed; the whole candidate set need not be connected. Join direction and result order do not affect grading. There is no partial-plan credit.

Reward is mean complete-plan coverage over ten questions. Invalid or late responses score zero for the affected question; the process can be restarted for later questions. Build failure or index-limit violations yield zero overall. A synthetic warmup is unscored; failure triggers restart rather than automatic loss of a scored question.

The full contract is in the benchmark's task instructions, task documentation, and runtime configuration.
